title: Dark Theme Contrast & Focus Improvements
description: Improved readability of encoded and decoded JWT sections in dark themes and added focus styling.

Fixed: Switched generated JWT textarea and decoded JSON previews from code-bg to bg-panel and text-text for proper contrast in dark themes (#3)
Changed: Added focus:border-accent and transition-colors to the generated JWT textarea

title: Tab UI & Theme Compliance
description: Reworked JWT Faker into a native editor panel tab and adopted Voiden theme tokens across all UI components.

Changed: Reworked JwtFakerModal full-screen dialog into a native Voiden editor panel tab (JwtFakerTab) that sits alongside document editors
Replaced hardcoded palette colors with Voiden theme classes (bg-panel, bg-editor, bg-active, bg-code-bg, text-text, text-comment, text-accent, text-alt, text-status-error, text-status-success)
Added Command Palette registration for opening JWT Faker generator and decoder tab
Added bundle renaming (dist/main.js) in release workflow for installer pipeline compatibility
Fixed: Declared the "commandPalette" permission in manifest.json, so the plugin loads when installed from a release instead of failing with a missing-permission error

title: Official Tooling & Status Bar Fix
description: Migrated project build and packaging pipeline to official @voiden/create-plugin scaffolding and fixed status bar item position.

Fixed: Added position: 'left' and label properties to registerStatusBarItem so the status bar button renders in Voiden UI
Changed: Scaffolded with official @voiden/create-plugin tooling (build.mjs, build-main.mjs, zip.mjs, generate-manifest.mjs)
Added npm run zip and npm run release commands for installer/registry zip asset generation

title: Initial Release
description: JWT Faker plugin for generating and decoding test JWTs in Voiden.

Added: HMAC SHA algorithms: HS256, HS384, HS512, and unsigned tokens (none)
JSON Header and Payload editors with live syntax validation
Quick claim action buttons for exp, iat, and nbf timestamps
Live token decoder and split inspector
Custom claim template presets and manager
